[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-im[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Signed Pomodoro start timing — `+N` starts later[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Inside a start's `<X>`, `-` starts earlier and `+` starts later (a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lone sign is one five-minute unit), so `=fix2+` writes exactly what[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`=fix2 ++` writes, `@foo:bar=+3` links and starts a task 15 minutes[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]later in one item, `x=` stays a past-only record with teaching [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]refusals, and Obsidian `se<X>` keeps byte-for-byte parity.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-im/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Signed `<X>` grammar, later clock, contracts, and link starts [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]in bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]signed_timing[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]signed_timing: extend `<X>` from `[D][-[N]]` to `[D][±[N]]` in bob-cli. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Add `later_units` to the start spec and summary, move the start later in[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`start_block_minute`, refuse `+0` and two signs, accept every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]leading-`+` form (`=+3`, `=3+2`, `=+fix`, `=3+1#deep-work`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`@foo:bar=+3`, `^foo:bar=3+`), carry the sign into fit drafts and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]human parse line, teach `x=3+`/`x=+`, bump the grammar revision, extend [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shared MEET vectors, and document it. Trailing `+` after a bare name[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stays a name byte until bare_plus.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Trailing `+` after bare names is timing; `#` spells names [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]ending in `+`[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]bare_plus[dim] · [dim][/dim]after signed_timing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bare_plus: a bare start name now ends at its last byte that is neither a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]digit nor `+`, so `=fix2+`, `=fix+3`, `=bugs+2`, and `@foo:bar=fix2+` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]are timing while `=bob+decks` and `=bob+2fa` are unchanged. Refuse [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`=c++`/`=fix++` with a three-way hint, make `=#c++` legal, teach [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`x=fix+`, keep timing in completion round trips, emit trailing timing in[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bare-name fit drafts, fix the stale `=bugs+2` docs, add the differential[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]test, bump the grammar revision, and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decisions:start-timing-is-signed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse operator-only bodies after a link start, teaching the [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]glued spelling[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]link_body[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bare_plus[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]link_body: an `@route:id\[#name]=<X>` item whose remaining text is only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]session-operator tokens (`@foo:bar= ++3`) is refused instead of creating[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a task titled `++3`; a single `++N` body teaches the folded spelling [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](`@foo:bar=+3`, `@foo:bar=fix2+`), and the `^route:id=<X> ++N` near miss[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]teaches the same fold. Bump the grammar revision and document it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian bob-ledger-tools `se<X>` learns `+` in bob-plugins[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]obsidian_parity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after signed_timing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]obsidian_parity: in bob-plugins, teach the bob-ledger-tools `se<X>` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snippet `se+`, `se+3`, `se3+`, and `se3+2` with the same later-start [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]math, refuse `se+0` and two signs, carry the sign into the MEET-conflict[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fit token, re-copy the shared meet_event_run vectors from bob-cli, map [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]signed tokens in the harness, update the plugin docs, build, test, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run `bob plugins sync`.[/#D7D7AF]
